questions.def: "Whose" indicates possession by the report, introducing the relative clause.
questions.question: The report, ___ conclusions were disputed, was eventually retracted.

questions.def: "Whose" shows possession, linking the author to their theories.
questions.question: The author, ___ theories are groundbreaking, is highly respected.

questions.def: "Whose" shows a possessive relation between policy and implementation.
questions.question: The policy, ___ implementation was flawed, has been revised.

questions.def: "To which" correctly introduces the non-restrictive relative clause.
questions.question: The article, ___ I referred earlier, provides valuable insights.

questions.def: Article "the" correctly identifies the data's accuracy.
questions.question: The data, ___ accuracy is questionable, needs verification.

questions.def: "Whose" indicates the document's conclusions are being referred to.
questions.question: The document, ___ conclusions are debated, is important.

questions.def: "Whose" indicates possession: the theory's proponents.
questions.question: The theory, ___ proponents are few, remains influential.

questions.def: "Whose" shows possession, connecting the experiment and its results.
questions.question: The experiment, ___ results were unexpected, surprised everyone.

questions.def: "Whose" is required to link the hypothesis and its validity.
questions.question: The hypothesis, ___ validity is uncertain, needs further study.

questions.def: "Whose" correctly shows that the headquarters belong to the company.
questions.question: The company, ___ headquarters are in London, is expanding.

questions.def: Article "the" correctly identifies the concept's complexity.
questions.question: The concept, ___ complexity is daunting, is crucial.

questions.def: "Whose" is needed to link the claim to its evidence.
questions.question: The claim, ___ evidence is lacking, was dismissed.

questions.def: "Whose" correctly shows that the articles belong to the journal.
questions.question: The journal, ___ articles are peer-reviewed, has high impact factor.

questions.def: Article "the" correctly identifies the argument's logic.
questions.question: The argument, ___ logic is flawed, is unconvincing.

questions.def: "Whose" is needed to link the theory to its assumptions.
questions.question: The theory, ___ assumptions are wrong, is now rejected.

questions.def: "Whose" correctly shows that the size belongs to the dataset.
questions.question: The dataset, ___ size is substantial, requires powerful processing.

questions.def: "Whose" shows possession, connecting the procedure and its success.
questions.question: The procedure, ___ success is guaranteed, is widely used.

questions.def: "Whose" is required to link the study and its findings.
questions.question: The study, ___ findings are conclusive, changed perceptions.

questions.def: "Whose" correctly shows that the derivation belongs to the formula.
questions.question: The formula, ___ derivation is complex, is widely applied.

questions.def: Article "the" correctly identifies the algorithm's efficiency.
questions.question: The algorithm, ___ efficiency is remarkable, is valuable.

questions.def: "Whose" is needed to link the theorem to its proof.
questions.question: The theorem, ___ proof is elegant, is foundational.

questions.def: "Whose" correctly shows that the predictions belong to the model.
questions.question: The model, ___ predictions are accurate, is widely used.

questions.def: Article "the" correctly identifies the software's reliability.
questions.question: The software, ___ reliability is critical, is well tested.

questions.def: 'Whose' indicates possession referring back to 'the report'.
questions.question: The report, ___ conclusions were widely disputed, was eventually retracted.

questions.def: 'Whose' shows possession (the candidate's charisma).
questions.question: The candidate, ___ charisma impressed many, ultimately failed to secure the nomination.

questions.def: Non-restrictive clauses require 'which,' not 'that'.
questions.question: The policy, that implementation proved difficult, was eventually abandoned.

questions.def: Past participle 'recommended' acts as a reduced relative clause.
questions.question: The changes ___ in the report will be implemented immediately.

questions.def: 'Which' introduces a non-restrictive relative clause.
questions.question: The article, ___ I found quite insightful, explored the nuances of quantum physics.

questions.def: 'Whose' indicates possession by the company.
questions.question: The company, ___ headquarters are in Geneva, is expanding its operations.

questions.def: 'Which', not 'that,' introduces a non-restrictive clause.
questions.question: The book, that I read last summer, was absolutely fascinating.
